verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice publishes a documented v3 REST API. It claims parity with the web client, uses OAuth 2.0 with permanent refresh tokens, documents rate limits (100 requests/min per organization), and offers a downloadable Postman collection, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probed OpenAPI paths returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The Zoho Invoice API allows you to perform all the operations that you do with our web client.
Zoho REST APIs uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate calls.
You can make 100 requests per minute per organization.
You can download our API collection and give it a swing.
